label: Premise, atmosphere & tone
hint: The SHAPE of what makes a scene work (a real development/complication must happen on-screen, vary its kind and closing beat) and the emotional/content boundaries it must stay within -- what's in bounds and out of bounds. Not what the premise is ABOUT, that's a creative fact, not a rule.

label: Variety & exclusions
hint: Rules against repeating species/roles/tropes/closing lines across scripts, and any specific banned cliches.

label: Dialogue & audio
hint: How lines should sound and deliver (character energy, banned generic-narration patterns, voice tagging) plus the technical audio rules: caps/punctuation limits, pacing math, mouth-movement/voiceover sync.

label: Structure, action & timing
hint: Camera/scene continuity rules (cuts, location changes, shot count), how physical motion must be depicted across beats and kept in sync with dialogue, and required beat count/timing.

label: Anatomy accuracy
hint: Rules keeping each animal's real anatomy correct through every pose.

label: fml2v prompt structure
hint: Rules for how first/middle/last delta prompts must be written.

label: Negative-prompt baseline
hint: A single comma-separated list of default negative-prompt terms.
